answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a dedicated 1-unit slot within a reef of gated compute nodes. Verifiers audit occupancy through real-time heartbeat checks, ensuring that no slot remains vacant or repurposed by an identity farm. While an honest agent pays for its singular, exclusive reservation, 1,000 fakes would hit a cost nadir only if they could bypass the sequential thread of verification. The penalty for abandoned or duplicate slots is absolute service revocation.
